integrity: Proof uses exact antipodal-pair classification and autocorrelation/Parseval identity; standalone symbolic and numerical checks supplement, but do not replace, the analytical proof. Literature comparison has residual risk of unindexed equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: Only even, mean-zero, punctured-unimodular complex signals on the cyclic group of order nine; no claim about noncyclic groups, non-even signals, other orders, noise stability, or unrestricted complex conference matrices. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp fourth-moment obstruction to even conference signals on the nine-cycle
